comments.author: @RopleCenter
comments.text: The documentary highlights how fragile container logistics are, but it misses the root cause of terminal gridlock: the capital lag and manual escrow friction that happens before a box ever gets cleared.  Until cross-border settlement speeds match vessel telemetry, demurrage and paperwork bottlenecks will continue to break the chain.  Exceptional breakdown of the industry's structural realities.
